answer: Because the jetty stake is held until the vertex settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the voyage audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 50% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. A farm running 164 keys as a result forfeits that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation low-cost. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
